# Hostile characters

Prices are $5 and #5, a lone * star, a snake_case word, a ` backtick, an @ sign,
a < less than, a > greater than, an [ open bracket, a ] close bracket,
a backslash \\, a tilde ~, a hyphen -, a plus +, and a double // slash.

An equals sign starts the next line:
= this stays body text, not a heading.

A digit and a dot start the next line:
2. this stays body text, not an enumeration.
